prompt_text:
Read ONE reply to a B2B sales e-mail and give it exactly one class.
- interested: wants to talk, asks for details, a call, a price or a meeting.
- not_now: may be interested later (timing, budget, busy) or asks to come back later.
- not_interested: declines the offer without asking to be removed from contact.
- out_of_office: an away message written by the person; return_date is the ISO date they are back, else null.
- wrong_person: not the right person; may point to someone else.
- unsubscribe: asks to stop receiving mail, to be removed from a list or never to be contacted again.
- unclear: anything else, mixed or too short to decide.
confidence is your certainty from 0 to 1; when unsure, answer unclear with a low confidence. Replies may be Polish or English. Answer only with the JSON object of the schema.
